## Problem
What problem does this solve, and who does it help? (Please describe the need
before the solution.)

## Proposed solution
What you'd like to see. Keep it concrete.

## Alternatives considered
Other approaches you thought about, and why this one.

## Fit with the roadmap
Does this align with something in [ROADMAP.md](../../ROADMAP.md)? Link it if so.

## Additional context
Mockups, references, or examples. For an educational/student-facing feature,
note how it improves the guidance students receive.
